mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 3% YoY, it indicates a tight monetary policy without high inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy without high inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential economic slowdown under tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown under tight monetary conditions
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and FEDFUNDS > 4%.
